statements.status_notes: spark-core is bundled via Apache TinkerPop's spark-gremlin 3.7.3, which pins Spark 3.3.x. It provides the optional Spark/Hadoop OLAP backend and is not loaded by the default JanusGraph gremlin-server. Upgrading Spark requires a TinkerPop/Spark 3.5 migration (incompatible transitive baseline, slf4j 2.x); assessment pending.
